newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BARCELONA JOIN QUEUE FOR BAYERN'S ZIEGE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA JOIN QUEUE FOR BAYERN'S ZIEGE.

text.p: Barcelona have joined the list of clubs interested in signing Bayern Munich full-back Christian Ziege, it was reported on Thursday.

Earlier media reports said Ziege was set to join AC Milan next season but Kicker soccer magazine said Arrigo Sacchi's arrival at the club and their early exit from the European Cup had forced them to change their plans.
Reports have also linked Ziege with Juventus of Italy and English premier league leaders Arsenal.
Barcelona told Bayern they would speak directly to Ziege, a key member of the German team which won the European championship earlier this year, Kicker said.
The report also said the Spanish side were ready to offer more than the fixed sum of 10.25 million marks ($6.6 million) needed to buy out Ziege's contract at the end of the season.
